summary.text: Josh Holstein is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 32, where he has served since 2020, and is seeking re-election against Democrat Jennifer Allyn Bias Bryant in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has chaired the Republican Party of West Virginia since July 2025.

paragraphs.text: Josh Holstein was born in Charleston, West Virginia, and graduated from Sherman High School.
His career experience includes working as a voter registration coordinator for the West Virginia Republican Party and as an intern at the U.S. House of Representatives.
Holstein's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session were Energy and Manufacturing, Political Subdivisions, and Senior, Children, and Family Issues.
